source_units.text: Write a monologue spoken by an imaginary chess piece.
Build the piece around these synthetic facts: The speaker is a rook who envies the knight but discovers pride in straight lines.
Include I am the rook and the edge of the board.
The text must contain "I am the rook", "straight lines", "the edge of the board" verbatim.
This will be read by readers of an original miniature monologue.
